Source: https://github.com/codrops/CardStackEffects

Six effect pairs (Yuda, Krisna, Wangi, Wira, Slamet, Eka) are extracted from upstream css/component.css. Keyframes are retained; selectors are scoped to the site’s deck. The site uses actual previous/next navigation and independent click-to-flip, rather than the original accept/reject semantics. No original images, icons, scoring, Modernizr or dynamics.js dependency is bundled.
